high_level_description: The image is a composite of two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a book cover titled "Outgrowing Modernity" by Vanessa Machado de Oliveira. The cover features a watercolor illustration of green leaves against a textured beige background. The title is written in a cursive, handwritten font, and the author's name is printed below it in a smaller, more formal script. The overall aesthetic of the cover is natural and organic, with a soft, earthy color palette.
